status.flown: Confirmed in a ship: root CLAUDE.md says it worked in flight (status_when: when, where it says).
status.unverified: Bound and loaded in the game, but not yet confirmed in a ship (CLAUDE.md says so).
status.trial: CLAUDE.md calls the binding a trial: bound to be tried out, not yet tried.
status.missing: No status key: the docs record neither a flight report nor a doubt about how that binding behaves. Doubts about which physical control carries a number, and about the game defaults the profile clears, are not statuses.

why.text: spaceship_power/defensive/movement/view/general, seat_general and lights are ALWAYS active, so their controls (AB6-wing power panel, WPN-hat shield faces, left-hat countermeasures, MTQ throttle/strafe/encoders) carry nothing else, except a stock tap/hold split ("AP" key, "ALT" key, COM hat press).

seat_general (missile-mode toggle, look-behind, the mode knob) is live in every operator mode; the one past breach of this rule was the mining-laser switch sharing js1_button4 with the missile-mode toggle (§6 item 18).

Always-active maps (power, defensive, movement, view, and seat_general) are deliberately not reused this way - that's why the AB6-wing power panel, the WPN-hat shield faces and the left-hat countermeasures are single-purpose.

spaceship_power is always live, so the eight wing buttons carry nothing else in any mode: the combat target-cycle bank that sat there was deleted (the user never used it; general cycling is on the COM hat and the MHG hats), and the Mining / Salvage banks moved to the MHG right hat (§6 item 22).

devices.legend: Throttle forward = axis RY, idle detent = 0, forward detent = full; reverse = MHG stick press 29, held. Nothing is output outside the two detents.  FLAPS & Speedbrake levers drive analog axes (Slider / Dial) in Mining / Salvage modes; detent buttons 31-43 are unbound.  WPN-hat shield faces act only on S3 Quadrant shields (trial).
